story.so_that: I can run agentic workflow Activities with the capabilities and safeguards appropriate to each task, with 100% of automated resolution cases and representative configured Story Analysis invocations using the expected settings without permission-related artifact failures
story.as_a: Software Engineer and AI Process Designer
story.i_want: to configure default and per-skill Devin models and tool permissions for each Skill Activity invocation

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Overrides are keyed by canonical skill name, including extract-story-intent, analyze-story, grade-story-analysis, and repair-story-analysis.
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given each listed canonical skill has a distinct override When each profile is resolved from SkillActivityInput.skill_name Then each skill receives only its matching override

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Configuration selection uses SkillActivityInput.skill_name and never natural-language prompt parsing.
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given SkillActivityInput.skill_name is analyze-story and its prompt mentions repair-story-analysis When configuration is resolved Then the analyze-story profile is selected

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: The generic Harness contract and existing skill output and sentinel contracts remain unchanged.
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a fake alternate Harness implements run(prompt, cwd) and an existing skill writes its current sentinel When run_skill executes Then the alternate Harness requires no Devin fields and the sentinel is read through its existing verify_params key

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Activity logs record the canonical skill name, effective model, and effective permission mode without credentials, prompt contents, or configuration-file contents.
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given analyze-story resolves to model SWE-1.7 and permission mode accept-edits When the Activity logs its invocation Then those three identifiers are present and credential values, prompt text, and configuration contents are absent

related_edge_cases.criterion: Concurrent invocations use immutable effective profiles
related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given two skills resolve different overrides concurrently When commands are constructed Then each command contains only its own effective model and permission mode

related_edge_cases.criterion: Interrupted invocation leaves a stale sentinel
related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given a previous attempt left a sentinel When run_skill begins a new invocation Then it removes the stale sentinel and accepts only a sentinel created by the current invocation
Given the host Devin CLI is unauthenticated When an Activity invokes it Then the harness reports the authentication failure without logging credentials
Given a skill resolves to accept-edits but the repository filesystem rejects a write When the skill runs Then the Activity fails through the harness or missing-sentinel path without reporting success

dependencies: docs/reqs/skill-activity-configs/streams/foundations.stream.json: invocation context contract and unchanged Harness boundary
docs/reqs/skill-activity-configs/streams/harness-configuration.stream.json: effective profile resolver consumed by DevinHarness

steps.description: Wrap run_skill's unchanged harness invocation in canonical skill context and guarantee context reset after success or failure.
Ensure invocation context propagates through the worker's Activity execution path and remains isolated for concurrent calls to the shared DevinHarness.

Add sanitized activity-log events for selected skill, effective model, effective permission mode, configuration rejection, launch, completion, and artifact verification failure without logging prompt or raw configuration.
Regression-test misleading prompt text, concurrent context isolation and cleanup, alternate Harness compatibility, stale sentinels, existing verify_params lookup, and safe logs.
